chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Jabbar from Safwan from Ibn Muskhan from Ibrahim ibn Maymun from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the man who converts to Islam and wishes to be circumcised, while Hajj is approaching: Does he perform Hajj or does he get circumcised? He said: 'He does not perform Hajj until he is circumcised.'

key_terms.حَضَرَ الْحَجُّ: Hajj is approaching / time for Hajj has arrived

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a new Muslim who needs circumcision when Hajj time arrives?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the prerequisite of physical purity is prioritized over the immediate performance of Hajj for a new convert, emphasizing that the ritual state of Ihram requires the completion of essential bodily conditions. This ruling reflects the Shia jurisprudential principle that major physical impediments to ritual validity must be resolved before engaging in acts of worship, ensuring the Hajj is performed in a state of complete readiness. The hadith underscores the integration of personal hygiene (Sunnah) with ritual obligation, highlighting that spiritual readiness includes physical completeness.
